description: This file defines React components for a command palette UI, including dialog, input, list, and item components, utilizing external libraries such as cmdk and lucide-react.

methods.name: Command
methods.description: React component wrapping CommandPrimitive with styling and props forwarding.

methods.name: CommandDialog
methods.description: React component rendering a dialog with a command palette inside, with customizable title and description.

methods.name: CommandInput
methods.description: React component rendering a styled input with a search icon for command input.

methods.name: CommandList
methods.description: React component rendering a scrollable list of command items.

methods.name: CommandEmpty
methods.description: React component indicating an empty command list.

methods.name: CommandGroup
methods.description: React component grouping command items with a heading.

methods.name: CommandSeparator
methods.description: React component rendering a separator line between command groups.

methods.name: CommandItem
methods.description: React component representing an individual command item with selection and disabled states.

methods.name: CommandShortcut
methods.description: React component displaying a shortcut key for commands.
